title: LS_34152_PH_ManilaWalk.mp3 by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Walking in Manila, Philippines. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect). This binaural audio file is one of the recordings I made in Manila a few days before Christmas 2018, while I was rambling in the shops and in the crowded streets of Divisoria and Baklaran, which are two places where you can find many sellers and vendors who sell everything you’d like to buy... Here, I’m walking in a small street with many small shops around. Recorded in December 2018 with an Olympus LS-3 and Soundman OKM I binaural microphones (version 2018). Fade in/out and high pass filter at 80Hz -6dB/oct applied
modifications: cut 111.46-126.46s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -19.00 dBFS); 30 ms fades
